results.text: This development marks a key step in the modernization of services, integrating technologies that allow continuous monitoring and faster customer intervention. Thanks to connected devices, infestations can be detected at the first signs, improving treatment efficacy and enabling proactive management based on reliable data. Already fully operational in Ireland, the solution will be gradually rolled out to other markets. In France, connected capture and multicapture will be launched in 2026, supported by the progressive development of a connected monitoring system. Each market has a specific adaptation to meet local needs. Data analysis is a key lever. The software accompanying this solution collects and analyzes key information on pest habits and risk areas, thereby improving service quality and anticipating customer needs. This approach is part of a responsible strategy, limiting environmental impact by reducing travel. It also promotes the development of internal practices by training teams in the use of connected tools to enhance their expertise. These levers strengthen our position as an innovative and committed player. Our connected solution illustrates our desire to combine innovation, efficiency, and responsibility to support the transformation of the sector. OUR CUSTOMERS Elis offers products and solutions suited to all business sectors to meet the needs of its customers. It has focused its rental and maintenance expertise on four markets: Hospitality, Industry, Healthcare, and Trade and Services. For each of these markets, Elis offers three main solution types: at linen, workwear, hygiene and well-being appliances. Our customers Customer eForce: 2025 was marked by two major rollouts, demonstrating the rapid acceleration of the Group's CRM project After an initial launch in the Netherlands in 2024, eForce reached a new milestone in 2025 with the launch in two additional countries: Ireland on April 2, followed by France on November 17, confirming the rollout momentum scheduled for the program. At the same time, the project teams began work with Norway and the United Kingdom, with a view to launching in 2026, which will be followed by the countries of Southern Europe: Spain, Portugal and Italy. I would also encourage you to monitor the improvement in EPS in 2026 and 2027, which will mark the transformation of the financial model.
